question: I've got leftover cooked rice, two lemons and mustard seeds. [health detail removed] and I have 25 minutes - what can I make?
answer:
You can make **Lemon Rice (Chitranna)** [lemon-rice-09@original::structure::0]. It takes about 20 minutes and uses your leftover cooked rice, mustard seeds, and two lemons (which yields the required 40g of juice) [lemon-rice-09@original::structure::0, lemon-rice-09@original::structure::1, lemon-rice-09@original::structure::2].

### Allergen note for your kid
* **Original recipe:** Marked as **UNSAFE** because it contains raw peanuts (nuts) [lemon-rice-09@original::structure::1, lemon-rice-09@original::structure::3]. 
* **Nut-free adjustment:** Swap the raw peanuts for **roasted chana dal** to keep the crunch [lemon-rice-09@original::find_substitutes]. With this substitution, the recipe is **SAFE BY DECLARATION** for a nut allergy [lemon-rice-09@original::check_allergens].

### Food safety note
Since you are using leftover cooked rice, ensure it is reheated thoroughly to a safe internal temperature of **74°C (165°F)** if serving it warm [food-safety-chart@original::structure::1].

hits.title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
hits.text:
# Lemon Rice (Chitranna) — version: original

A 20-minute tempered rice for leftover rice: sharp, bright and crunchy.

hits.title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
hits.text:
# Lemon Rice (Chitranna) — version: original

## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount |
|---|---|
| Cooked rice, cooled | 600g |
| Lemon juice (about 2 lemons) | 40g |
| Sunflower oil | 30g |
| Peanuts, raw | 40g |
| Mustard seeds | 5g |
| Chana dal | 10g |
| Urad dal | 5g |
| Green chillies, slit | 2 |
| Curry leaves | 1 sprig |
| Turmeric powder | 2g |
| Asafoetida (hing) | 1g |
| Salt | 8g |

Yield: serves 3.

hits.title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
hits.text:
# Lemon Rice (Chitranna) — version: original

## Method

Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool and separate the grains. Heat the
oil, add the mustard seeds and let them crackle, then the chana dal, urad
dal and peanuts, and fry until the dals are golden and the peanuts crisp.
Add the green chillies, curry leaves, asafoetida and turmeric, and fry 10
seconds. Take the pan off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and salt, then
fold the tempering through the rice until every grain is yellow. Ready in
about 20 minutes from cooked rice.

hits.title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
hits.text:
# Lemon Rice (Chitranna) — version: original

## Allergen note

Contains peanuts and mustard. Asafoetida is usually bound with wheat flour —
use a certified gluten-free hing for gluten-free diets.
